rules_to_change: low_reduction_score -> needs_review or ready_with_warnings, not automatic needs_retry
valid parseable reduction with source refs -> not needs_retry by default
rules_to_keep: provider/auth/timeout -> needs_retry or failed depending recoverability
suspicious_thresholds: score threshold that turned 13/20 valid chapters into retry
object/relation minimums not calibrated for short/quiet chapters
avoid_false_retries: separate technical validity from semantic richness
calibrate density by chapter length and narrative function
low_density_mapping: needs_review unless output is incomplete or invalid
thin_no_item_mapping: needs_review or ready_with_warnings when chapter valid; needs_retry only if required section missing due truncation/incompletion
tests_next_phase: valid low-density reduction maps to needs_review
writer outcome counts do not expose internals
retry plan excludes valid low-density chapters by default
